verdict.rationale: Jira is a SaaS product with AI features (Rovo), so whether customer data can be kept out of model training is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any training-exclusion control. The audit trail, sandboxes, and SAML/SSO items are adjacent controls that do not address model-training use of data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
